cards.credit: d2d is the work of the d2decomped project by psi29a (GPL-3.0-or-later). Our fixes go upstream as open pull requests.
d2d: An open-source reimplementation of the Diablo II engine.
It runs the bot without a screen and far faster than real time.
The original game stays as the reference we compare against.

fidelity.label: Speed
fidelity.value: 22 to 33x faster than the game clock

fidelity.label: Matches so far
fidelity.value: mana and stamina regeneration, XP penalty table, resist penalties, death rules

fidelity.label: Known differences
fidelity.value: some spell cast speeds, one potion bonus, a few vendor prices

fidelity.label: Our bar
fidelity.value: key numbers within 20 percent of the original game

cards.fidelity_title: How close is d2d to the original game?
cards.goal: A bot that plays Diablo II: Lord of Destruction by itself, offline, for hours, with a game of goals and progress built around it.
how: The bot looks at the game: health, position, items.
It presses keys and moves the mouse like a person.
A watchdog steps in when it is stuck or in danger.
The goal layer decides what to work toward.
